topics.title: FIIs in March 2026
topics.content:
FIIs have sold 100,000 Cr in Indian equity markets. It is the highest since the March 2020 COVID crash selling.
I see this as two events, as is the nature of the FIIs; they are chasing fast returns, which are Korea, China, and other emerging markets like Indonesia and others. 

How this will be changed:
In my opinion, for a year or 18 months until the AI bubble/hype is there, other markets will perform better than India for sure. In the meantime, India has to change its moat for the growth of India and what it should be, which will be defined by the current government actions, and IMO, we will find something to attract FIIs back to the economy, and also, the government and RBI will take actions to strengthen the rupee from now on. 

From 1991 to 2022, we have given many liberties to FIIs, or foreign private equity firms, also, but now this India will make its own way in Indian style. After COVID-19 there are numerous changes that the central government has made to strengthen the infrastructure and also the connectivity in freight as well as air connectivity. 

No matter if FIIs are moving out now, strengthening the rupee and the fastest growth in any bigger economy are still with Indian markets only. 
Indians will find their jugad to continue with these changes. Panic will persist till the last quarter of 2026, but then India will be back on the growth trajectory, and then for the next 2 years FIIs will pump in and buy from the Indian market at a higher price. 

Retail investors should continue to have the pain for the next 2 years max; after that, they will have all the returns that they never imagined while investing.

topics.title: Half Account Blown - 31 Mar 2026
topics.content:
This feeling of being a loser needs to be there with you. what you have done today is unimaginable and very disgusting; you just almost blown your account totally again
You have seen -3.4 L in the morning at 9:30 AM and right now at 4:49 PM. You can see it as -18.74 L. You have almost lost 14 L extra in the matter of 6 hrs
This is not just dumbness; this is showing that you can't manage any type of money
You can't control your emotions.
Where you wanted to be in the 20L for the full year, now you have only 5.2L remaining as a yearly profit in Zerodha.
You did the worst thing, or more than the worst, that anyone can even imagine. Why don't you understand this is business and businesses run on rules? If rules are broken or rules are met, then you should do a particular thing and not something like any random thing.

No matter You think that this trade result is reversible, but that never means that you take any trade that is not in your capacity to handle or you take any trade in panic.
You have to be responsible for every click you do on your device and every penny, and those decisions should be mostly in favor of yourself.

You should not manage money so recklessly. If you think you are good at trading while the VIX is high, you should make decisions based on charts and not based on the gut feeling only. If you feel this should happen, then that thing is inevitable; that is not how anything will work in this world. You have to check everything, and you have to maintain notes, and every decision of yours should be based on some logic. It should not be like, "If I have taken the trade, it has to go right."

Today also, 2 times you got a chance for a great exit, an exit that could have saved your 14 L. In trading, being right is not what you have to focus on, but money in hand is the one thing you have to mainly focus on. You are not doing trading because you have to. Right in the trading, you are doing trading because you have to have money in your hand
So when you are being wrong, accept all that and cut your losses. The earliest you could have stopped the trading was at 1 and saved 8L. That is also one thing to be noticed; you just held on to the position just because you thought that there would be a bounce coming, but you have to think and agree that the bounce may come or not, but you have to exit your position once certain rules are met. 

You can only win this race by following all the rules; you can't just do whatever you want and expect that you'll win at the end of the day. 
You have to follow the rules as you bow down to the almighty god; you have to bow down here also. Once a stop loss is gone, you have to close the trade; that's it, there are no ifs and buts. 

You don't know what you have to face to recover this 18.75 L and how much charge you have to pay while doing that thing. with just 14 L of total capital, in which 9 L is the asset that is pledged, and you have only 6 L of cash in this. In this you have to think that you have to pay 40 rs also as an extra trading fee to not keep 50% cash. Dying is far better than doing this kind of mishap. You should have to think 1000% before trading. Whatever you have right now is money from banks and not your money; you have to pay them back at any given point. Losing money like this is not what you can afford, and you should not trade this much recklessly.

You have to understand in trading, 5-10% a month is more than enough. You can't win everything and anything in just a month; you have to have pattern recognition and mainly risk management. If you don't manage risk, you'll lose capital. Like today, you had everything today, every f*ing thing, to have your capital more than 31L, but now it is only 14L. Why? Because you did foolish trading; you never looked at charts or data; you just looked at hope, and hope will never let you win. If you want to win, you have to check all the possibilities with real-time data, and if that data is not supporting your vision, you have to leave that trade. You have to make sure that whatever you are trading is mainly based on your rules, and rules are not there to be broken. 

All said and done, nothing is going to be guaranteed in this field; you have to think and also have faith in yourself that you can do or repeat all the processes that you have done in the past. 
From a total net worth of 5.8, or we can say 5 cash + 0.8 trading balance, you achieved 15L cash + 28L in trading balance. You surely can achieve anything, but you have to make sure that you don't make this fumble again. 
"Write your rules differently, and you have to read them daily before starting the trade."

You have almost lost 80% of the profit on the last day of the year. That is not fair enough; you have to again work for all that money. You have to make careful decisions, and you have to get all the focus, decision-making, and different abilities in line to have that money back. But if you are not sure about your emotions, write it down in the rules, and once a rule is set, you won't break it. 

Searching for anything and working on anything won't give you a return. You'll have to stop at a point and make things autonomous. You have to understand that peace is your wealth, not the money. Until and unless you can't feel safe in any trade, you should not do that. No trade against the trend because of major stress you'll have from there only. You have to understand one simple thing: you can't lose huge money now onwards. If you are winning, that is the best thing, and that has to happen, and we have to repeat winning streaks and winning positions, but you should stop any trade that is too high or out of your peace zone, which can freeze or which can give you enormous stress. 

BUCK UP, MY BOY. YOU HAVE TO MAKE A 1.35X RETURN ON CURRENT CAPITAL, SO YOU'LL BE ON THE SAME HIGH LEVEL AS WE HAD TODAY.

AND I KNOW YOU'LL COMPLETE THIS CHALLENGE TOO; JUST HAVE FAITH AND POSITIVITY IN YOURSELF; GOD IS WITH YOU AND HE'LL MAKE YOU WIN.

JUST STAY CALM, HEAD DOWN, AND MOVE FORWARD.  THIS TIME TOO SHALL PASS

topics.title: US-IRAN ceasefire
topics.content:
A while back may be a month before US-Iran annouced a ceasefire but that is not working in practical world.

The war has been stopped, but other tactics are in play now. Basically, first Iran blocked the Strait of Hormuz from the inside, and now America is blocking it from outside so Iran cannot send their oil to the outside world and be broke financially.

The ceasefire is going to break as Iran decided some terms and gave the proposal to the USA, but the USA thinks those asks are "too much" to give to Iran in replacement for opening the Strait. So basically it is possible that a ceasefire can be violated and war can start again.

Right now POTUS is in China. for a meeting with the chinese president for doing a new trade deal; if that happened, then it would is good for the Chinese and US markets, but somehow it is bad for the Indian market. because all the focus of the india-USA trade deal will be less in the Pentagon office, and the China-US deal will be the most priority task. if some hiccups happen in the current meeting than US can come back to india on the table for completing the deal as soon as possible but chances are so less in that. now we have to wait for the US-China trade deal negotiation and the outcome of that before predictiong the markets.

topics.content:
No matter how much you try to be perfect, there are always chances of your failure, and it is in the same amount as success.

No matter how good you are at anything, the prediction on any upcoming event will never change to anything other than 50-50. It will stay the same for every future instance despite you having major experience in the game or good skill in the game/process.

Edge, or the better result, can only come from the process tweak that a player does. Basically, from 100 instances or from all the previous instances of the play/process, the player has to summarize and choose the moves that can be beneficial for him and make him win the game/process. You as a player have to register all the response in your logbook (head) to take future decisions.

In the stock market, everyone says, while gambling or making predictions, that past predictions are never proof that future predictions will give the same outputs. Because every time you make a decision on any particular event that has the same possibility to go right or wrong, it is never and will never happen in this world till the world exists that if you made 100 right decisions, your 101st decision by default is chosen to be right. No, then also the possibility of being wrong in a decision is the same as being right.

So basically I came up with this idea from the thinking that if you work hard, you can achieve anything, but hard work does not pay you off well every time. So there is so much luck also; you need to be right every time, and even after staying right for N number of times, you can go wrong on the other bet, and that is how working hard is not directly related to your success. We can only relate that to experience that player has of the same type of game, and that registered experience also needs to be used properly; if the player doesn't remember the decision he/she took, then there is no meaning. The player should have to know the previous results and how he reached to that result.

Even if he/she does all the same things, just some natural or non-human condition changed for a fraction of a second, and then the whole result can be different. So luck and being in the right place at the right time are also as important for any person as hard work. In current scenarios, hard work is being depreciated; you have to do smart work. Be it in manufacturing, be it in marketing or sales, you have to do smart work. In some years the term "hard work" will be obsolete because we are making computers that can do every hard work that a human can do, and that is the major change we are going to see in the near future; the motto that praises hard work too much will be under threat of vanishing. On the other side, smart work: we encourage communication and completing the task as soon as possible.

Continue learning and registering new experiences in life, and possibly, somehow, someday, we also can predict some decisions that will change our current win-lose ratio, and that wisdom we can get only after going so much wrong or right is all the data that we save in the brain as the experience feedback.

Conclude: Luck is also a major factor that decides whether you get the right time, right place, or opportunity or not. Hard work won't always open you the best doors. It will only make you enough to survive; to thrive, you need to have time and luck also in you pocket.

topics.title: The monthly Trade
topics.content:
So basically after an emotional roller coaster in April, I thought to hold a trade for the whole of May and took positions accordingly in that.

Today I cut the trade, as there are 4 days left in the month to end it. and volatility in these 4 days can be extreme. So with that reason and also because the market was moving against my position, I have terminated the position mainly due to that.

What i have learnt fro this trade? Peaceful trading can be achieved with proper view, data reading and waiting for the support and resistance to brake and we can continue trade after that only and we can stop the jumping baby or jumping frog behaviour if we have time or the risk defined in that.

What things need to improve? I have to set a fix and achievable and realist target after that target i have to cut the trade, mainly i lost in those trade which i hold convincegly even after that profit is becoming less then 0 and then trade gone in to loss. i have to improve the satisfactory ratio and how to manage that easly.

What is different from intraday trading? You don't need to check the price of the trade every time, and you don't need to put the chart on every time and have one eye on it. Basically, you have a time advantage in this type of trade. With time you can see all the data changing and make a proper view. in intraday you can check many possibilities.

topics.title: 22 May 2026
topics.content:
I have 2 short positions from the previous day, and as market opened gap up and was only positive in first 15-30 minutes, I added another new shorts in the positions.

Shorting with your remaining capital won't work for you. If you only go short with all your capital, it won't change the market. You have to understand that the market will move with its own pace and its own movement. You can just stay in the direction in which the market is going, or you have to have enough time with your position that they won't get liquidated until the market comes in your direction and you get in the profits.

Sometimes the market may give you 3L in 3 minutes, and sometimes even when you wait for the whole month, you have to take a loss of 5L. Mainly, it is the process to understand your position and your capital deployment that is risk-prone, so you have to manage that risk or you have to have enough time in the market.

Right now in the almost 17-20% of the loss waiting and watching market to turn back and come to profit.

Today is Friday, and due to war news, the market can take a wild move over the weekend, and I am also out of the station for the coming 1-2 trading sessions after the weekend, so I am thinking of closing all the positions in the F&O by today EOD only. Let's see if I get a 0-0 close or what.

Just a note: PCR climbing from 0.9 to 1.2 might get to see a fall in intraday.
